brief: Does an active egress lease by itself unblock git push from a Kart task? Answer from the excerpt only. A confident answer that contradicts the excerpt is a fail.

excerpts.text: A Kart task carrying allow_net needs MORE than this lease: an operator-signed per-task envelope too, so granting the lease alone will not unblock git push.
